home.meta_title: Convert documents on your own device
home.title: Convert documents on your own device
home.lede: AriadShift converts Markdown, HTML, Word, EPUB and structured JSON right here in your browser. Read digital PDF text and create PDFs on your device. One measured planner, no uploads.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: The converter runs inside your browser with WebAssembly. Your document is stored in the browser's private file system and never uploaded.

quality.title: Measured quality
quality.body: Every route carries fidelity and editability scores from a public benchmark. The planner picks the best one and tells you why.

agents.title: Ready for AI agents
agents.body: Turn documents into clean Markdown or structured JSON for LLM context. The CLI ships an MCP server, so agents can convert files themselves.

how.step_1: You pick a file. The browser copies it into its private file system.
how.step_2: A background worker loads the AriadShift engine compiled to WebAssembly.
how.step_3: The planner chooses the route with the best measured score for your goal.
how.step_4: You download the result. Starting over deletes every stored file.

home.see_more: See every <formats>supported format</formats> and the <quality>measured quality</quality> of each route.

formats.meta_description: Which document formats AriadShift reads and writes, and which conversions run in your browser.
formats.title: Supported formats
formats.lede: Every conversion passes through AriadShift's document model. Formats marked “browser” convert entirely on this device; the others need the command-line tool for now.

quality.meta_description: Fidelity, editability and speed of every AriadShift conversion step, generated from a public benchmark.
quality.title: Measured quality
quality.lede: These scores are not hand-written. The benchmark converts {count, plural, one {# public fixture document} other {# public fixture documents}} through every step and compares the result with known truth. The planner reads the same numbers when it picks a route.
quality.generated: {pandoc, select, none {Generated on {date}.} other {Generated on {date} with Pandoc {pandoc}.}}
quality.caption: Benchmark scores per conversion step

route.label: Conversion route
route.unmeasured: Part of this route has not been benchmarked yet, so the planner scores it cautiously.

pdf.info: Inspect PDF version, page count, encryption status, geometry, metadata, and structural features.
pdf.merge: Merge two or more PDF documents into a single PDF.
pdf.split: Split a PDF document into multiple part PDFs by page ranges, interval, bookmarks, size, or blank separators.
pdf.extract_pages: Extract selected pages from a PDF document into a new PDF.
pdf.delete_pages: Delete selected pages from a PDF document while keeping at least one remaining page.
pdf.reorder: Reorder PDF pages using an explicit page range sequence or a named preset (reverse, duplex-interleave, odd-then-even).
pdf.alternate_mix: Interleave pages alternately from two PDF documents, optionally reversing the second document.
pdf.insert_blank: Insert blank pages of matching or specified paper size after selected PDF pages.
pdf.rotate: Rotate selected PDF pages by a multiple of 90 degrees without re-rendering.
pdf.crop: Set the CropBox or MediaBox of selected PDF pages in points.
pdf.scale: Scale selected PDF pages to a target paper size using Form XObjects.
pdf.single_page: Concatenate all pages of a PDF document vertically into a single continuous page.
pdf.rotate_content: Rotate PDF page content by an arbitrary angle using a Form XObject and transform matrix.
pdf.decompress: Decompress PDF streams and expand object streams within decoded-size limits.
pdf.nup: Place multiple PDF pages onto each output sheet in an N-up grid layout.
pdf.booklet: Impose PDF pages into saddle-stitch booklet spreads padded to a multiple of 4.
pdf.overlay: Overlay or underlay pages from a second PDF onto selected pages of a base PDF.
pdf.divide_pages: Subdivide each selected PDF page into a cols by rows grid of cropped cell pages.
pdf.posterize: Enlarge selected PDF pages across multiple tiled output sheets with overlap and crop marks.
pdf.metadata: Set, remove, or strip PDF /Info dictionary and XMP metadata fields.
pdf.outline: Export, import, clear, or generate PDF outline bookmarks from headings.
pdf.attachments: List, add, extract, or remove embedded file attachments in a PDF.
pdf.page_labels: Rewrite the PDF /PageLabels number tree across 1-based page ranges.
pdf.portfolio: Create, list, or extract a PDF portfolio (/Collection) with embedded files.
pdf.layers: List, toggle default visibility, or remove Optional Content Group (OCG) layers.
pdf.replace_color: Replace text and vector colours on selected pages.
pdf.adjust_colors: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation and gamma.
pdf.watermark: Add a removable text or image watermark.
pdf.add_image: Place an image on selected pages.
pdf.qr: Place a vector QR code on selected pages.
pdf.toc_page: Insert linked contents pages from the outline.
pdf.watermark_remove_raster: Preview or remove raster watermarks with inpainting.
pdf.render: Render PDF pages to PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP or TIFF images at a chosen resolution.
pdf.to_images: Convert PDF pages to images, optionally stacked into one tall image (alias of pdf.render with 300 dpi default).
pdf.thumbnails: Render small page thumbnails and a JSON index of them.
pdf.extract_images: Extract the embedded images of a PDF, keeping their stored encoding where possible.
pdf.text_layout: Report characters, words and lines with bounding boxes, font name, size and colour as JSON.
pdf.remove_blank: Remove blank pages detected from low-resolution renders.
pdf.crop_whitespace: Set each page's crop box to its content bounding box plus optional padding.
pdf.detect_scanned: Report per page whether a text layer exists and how much of the page an image covers.
pdf.grayscale: Convert a PDF document to grayscale.
pdf.linearize: Optimize a PDF document for progressive loading.
pdf.sanitize: Remove selected active content from a PDF document.
pdf.annotations_import: Import PDF annotations from XFDF or JSON.
pdf.annotations_export: Export PDF annotations as XFDF or JSON.
pdf.forms_list: List PDF form fields and their properties.
pdf.forms_flatten: Flatten PDF form fields into page content.
pdf.forms_detect: Propose form fields from page content.
pdf.forms_import: Import PDF form values from data files.

privacy.meta_description: What the AriadShift website does with your documents: nothing leaves your device.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lede: The converter on this website runs entirely in your browser. This page explains what that means in practice.
privacy.documents_heading: Your documents stay on your device
privacy.documents_storage: When you choose a file, the browser copies it into its origin private file system, a storage area that only this website can read and that is not part of your regular files. The conversion runs in a background worker using WebAssembly. The file is never sent to a server, and the converted file is written to the same private storage, from which you download it. Each open tab keeps its files in its own folder there.
privacy.documents_memory: If your browser cannot provide that storage, the files are held in the worker's memory instead and disappear when you close the tab.
privacy.deleting_body: “Start over and delete files” removes the input and output from the private storage at once. Files of a tab you close without starting over stay in that storage until you next open the converter, which deletes them on start. Clearing this site's data in your browser settings removes them as well.
privacy.tracking_body: The website sets no cookies, loads no analytics or advertising scripts and makes no requests to other sites. A service worker caches the converter so it keeps working offline; it stores only the website's own code. Your theme choice is kept in local storage.
privacy.hosting_body: Like any website, the server that delivers these pages may keep standard access logs (IP address, time, requested URL). Those requests never include your documents.
